section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 1. Amelia Enterprise Acquisition Integration & Synergies
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: SoundHound's acquisition of conversational AI leader Amelia significantly expands its TAM into enterprise customer service, financial services, and healthcare. Investors are probing whether Amelia's enterprise sales cycles are integrating smoothly or experiencing post-merger integration friction.

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 2. High Short Interest Dynamics & Squeeze Risk (41.35% Float)
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: With 41.35% of floating shares sold short, SoundHound is one of the most heavily shorted artificial intelligence equities on Wall Street. Any upside surprise in restaurant ordering ARR or automotive voice wins could trigger a violent squeeze toward consensus mean price targets ($12.57, +205% upside).

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 3. Cash Burn Trajectory & True FCF Conversion (-$57.50M)
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: Operating cash flow was -$33.71M in Q2 2026, and True Free Cash Flow was -$57.50M after accounting for $20.62M in stock-based compensation. While SoundHound holds over $200M in cash and equivalents, analysts on the conference call will press CFO Nitesh Sharan on the burn trajectory and capital requirements.
